title: Leo XIV, Trying to Be Everyone’s Pope, Heads to Secular France
summary: After touring Africa, Pope Leo’s four-day visit to France shows how he is seeking to appeal to Roman Catholicism’s original heartlands as well as to the church’s newest strongholds.
